## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and results, or explain why a check was not run.

## Version and release notes

- Version impact: patch / minor / major / no release needed (explain).
- Changelog entry: link to the Unreleased or prepared release notes.
- Migration or configuration changes: describe, or write none.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The branch and commits contain focused, clearly described changes.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed; limitations are documented.
- [ ] Changelog and documentation reflect the changes, or an omission is explained.
- [ ] For a release PR, VERSION, the dated changelog entry, and version references agree.
- [ ] Credentials and live dataset contents are excluded.

The user reviews this PR and decides whether to merge.
